objective.name: tools
objective.description: Prepare a projection of the tools of registered MCP servers that a model may be offered: bounded, filtered by the registry, with model-visible names and fingerprints.

#root.role: Read the current registry, list the tools of the requested enabled servers through the MCP SDK under bounded limits, keep those the registry allows, give each a provider-safe model-visible name and a fingerprint of its entry and input schema, and persist the projection that binds each model-visible name to its server, remote tool and schema.

transformation_contract.morphing: A list of registered server aliases becomes a persisted, bounded projection of the tools a model may call, with the servers that could not be prepared.
invariants: Only servers present and enabled in the registry installed on the machine are listed; an alias the registry does not know is reported unavailable, never contacted.
Only tools the registry allows for the server are projected (explicit mode: the listed names only); a remote annotation never widens or narrows that choice.

Each tool entry is { model_name, description, input_schema }; model_name matches [a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}, is unique in the projection, and carries a stable hash suffix whenever sanitization or truncation could collide.
Listing is bounded per server: at most 5 pages, 200 tools, 512 KiB, and a deadline; a projection holds at most 40 tools.
Remote descriptions and schemas are external untrusted data: they are bounded and returned as data, never as instructions.
The projection is persisted in the private store before it is returned, so a gateway restart does not lose it; it records the registry version and the fingerprint of every projected tool.
Servers are prepared in parallel; one slow or failing optional server does not remove the others.
success: The payload names a projection_id usable by call until expires_at, the registry version it was built from, the projected tools, and every requested server that could not be prepared with its reason.
failure: invalid: servers is not a list of aliases.
refused (reason policy_denied): no registry is installed or it cannot be read; nothing is contacted.
refused (reason mandatory_unavailable): a server listed in mandatory could not be prepared.
notes: servers absent or empty means every enabled server of the registry; mandatory is a subset of servers.
A projection grants nothing by itself: every call through it is checked again against the current registry. That is why tools carries no authority envelope.
unavailable entries are { server, reason } with reason among not_registered, disabled, authentication_required, deadline, transport, protocol, catalog_too_large.

effects.private_store: Writes one projection file in the wrapper's private store.
effects.remote_servers: Opens or reuses an MCP session with each requested server and sends tools/list requests.
